name: Harris Teeter Distribution Center Greensboro NC

fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence runs along Distribution Dr (confirmed in 2026-02 Street View). Truck drive enters through a gap with sliding/swing gate panels at the NE off Distribution Dr (~36.0954,-79.9306).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the truck entrance in any Street View heading; entrance is open paved drive with fence, light poles and a fire-dept standpipe only.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack, so access is via kiosk/badge/call-box. Set true per rubric (gate true + guardShack false).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard between buildings inside the fence provides ample inside-gate staging before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide internal apron and deep yard hold well over 3 trucks between gate and docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and unused paved width at the Distribution Dr entrance leave room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on opposite long faces of the main building (NE and SW), plus a separate perishable building with its own docks; medium confidence on strict ship/rcv split.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ across the campus: long dock rows on both long faces of the main frozen/grocery building and on the perishable building to the NE. ~95 is a rough campus total.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ parked trailers in fenced drop rows on the W/SW and N of the campus; hundreds visible.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 3 large warehouse buildings (frozen, dry grocery, perishable) plus an office; corroborated by web research (174k sf + 50k sf perishable additions).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense industrial park inside the Greensboro/PTI metro fabric adjacent to Piedmont Triad International Airport.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible on the property.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single combined in/out truck drive observed; lane count approximate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the fenced perimeter polygon; approximate.

citations.claim: Harris Teeter official careers portal lists Greensboro NC as an active distribution facility with Transportation, Freezer, and General Merchandise warehouse sections.
Active HT-branded Greensboro Distribution Center reqs (CDL Driver, Freezer Selector, General Merchandise Selector) current as of 2026-06 confirm HT self-operation.

verification.rationale: Tier-1 HT careers portal + active 2026 HT-branded Greensboro DC reqs confirm HT self-operates the frozen/grocery/perishable DC campus (200 Distribution Dr); the only closures found are unrelated HT-Delivery e-commerce sites elsewhere, not Greensboro.
